notes.content: When the kitchen outlets lose power, reset the breaker marked K2 in the hall cupboard. If it trips again, call the electrician instead of resetting it repeatedly.
The aquarium filter must keep running while we are away. Theo will feed the fish a small pinch every other morning.
The cordless drill stopped holding a charge. Its replacement battery must be from the 18-volt range; the 12-volt packs do not fit.
The translator's quote covers the instruction booklet only. Translating the packaging will require a separate estimate.
The piano teacher moved our first lesson to Thursday evening. Bring the beginner book and a pencil, but no instrument.
We stopped recording the weekly staff meeting because people were reluctant to discuss unfinished ideas on camera. Written decisions will still be shared afterward.
The cucumber batch was too soft because I used hot brine. For the next jar, cool the liquid before pouring it over the vegetables.
The branch rubbing against the gutter should be removed in winter while the tree is dormant. Arborist Elena will check the larger limbs first.
For the school picnic, label the sesame dressing separately. Robin cannot eat sesame, even in small amounts.
The jacket can be returned within thirty days if the tags remain attached. The receipt is in the little pocket of the blue shopping bag.
Keep the old database read-only during the migration. New writes go to the replacement service, and we reconcile counts before removing the old copy.
The grant proposal needs the principal investigator's signature before submission. The finance review alone is not sufficient approval.
At the mountain lodge, collect the room key from the wooden box by reception after hours. The host will send the box access code on arrival day.
For the tomato sauce, roast the garlic first to soften its sharp taste. Add the basil only after taking the pan off the heat.
My wireless headphones disconnect when they are paired to both the tablet and laptop. Turn off Bluetooth on the tablet during video calls.
The label printer jams when the roll is threaded beneath the guide. Feed it over the guide with the adhesive side facing down.
The customer webinar will be recorded and shared with everyone who registered. Written questions can be submitted during the event.
The office key cabinet is behind the reception desk. Visitors must return borrowed badges before leaving.
The dashboard reads from the reporting replica. It is expected to trail production writes by a few seconds.
The picnic shopping list includes tomatoes, cucumbers, bread, and bottled water. Keep the cold items in an insulated bag.
